soldier: The small soldier is paler in body colour than the large soldier and also smaller in body size. The length of the head including the nasus is about 1.7 times the width of the head; the median depression of the posterior margin of the head is deeper; the nasus is longer than half the length of the head and extends straight forwards, its tip not upturned in profile; the mandibles lack an apical spine; antennae mostly with 13 segments; the remaining morphology as in the large soldier.
